startup-50.provenance: Deterministic programmatic social card for The Deshi Startup 50. 1200x630 editorial folio: a deep-green left field with an oversized warm-white 50 or ৫০, and a warm-paper identity field with the localized title and approved watch line, thin warm rules, the Deshi Startup mark at top right, and a short green URL. Flat, clean, high-contrast, no gradients, shadows, logo wall, screenshot, ranking badges, or decorative clutter. English and Bangla versions use identical geometry; Bangla uses the bundled Deshi Sans Bengali font with full-script shaping.
